title: A stored cross site scripting attack when viewing email aliases in postfixadmin 4.0 before 4.0.7, and postfixadmin 3.3…
description: PostfixAdmin versions 4.0 before 4.0.7 and 3.3 before 3.3.17 are vulnerable to a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) attack. This vulnerability allows signed-in administrators to inject malicious scripts via email aliases, which are then executed when viewing those aliases.
